🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector breadth (10/11) argues against a clear risk-off; Confirmation 2: large-cap Tech divergence with multiple majors BELOW TREND (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND) keeps the call neutral.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: TGT (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: HD (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND, SBUX (1W: +8.13% | 1M: -2.18%) RECOVERY. Financials showing strength: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weakness: XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +1.58%) CORRECTION. Technology is internally rotating: large-cap software weak while semiconductors lead (see below). Healthcare is mixed/flat with pockets of strength and some headline-driven weakness.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -4.42% | 1M: +26.84%) CORRECTION; ACN (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION; AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND; PLTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.58%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) RECOVERY and TSLA (1W: +3.95% | 1M: -8.72%) RECOVERY highlight a MAJOR DIVERGENCE across megacaps — tactical caution advised.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed rotation within Tech: semiconductors leading (INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND) while mega-cap software and platforms show broad BELOW TREND readings (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND). Sector action is internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND signals bank-led strength, while card names are mixed (V (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION; MA (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND). Breadth in Financials supports risk exposure but be selective.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows defensive support but mixed news flow: JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%) ABOVE TREND underpin the group while headline risk exists elsewhere; overall the sector is steady.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Tilt toward cyclicals and semiconductors: favor exposure to INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, and select Financials such as JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing BELOW TREND such as AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given semis vs mega-cap software split.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Semiconductors/Technology (semis leading within Tech). BULLISH: Financials for continued bank/credit thrust. BEARISH: Large-cap software/platforms if earnings/sentiment continues to deteriorate.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch semis for continuation off this week’s breakouts (INTC, AMAT, LRCX) as momentum confirmation triggers further allocation; NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) RECOVERY hold of short-term support is a trigger for broader Tech sentiment; AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND reclaiming last week’s low would be a necessary signal to reduce downside risk.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (IMAAVY breakthrough) confirms price strength. AMD (+60): AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND — Meta AI chip pact aligns with the 1W/1M strength. LLY (+55): LLY (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND — pipeline news confirms accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-80): TSLA (1W: +3.95% | 1M: -8.72%) RECOVERY — very negative headlines diverge from a short-term bounce, monitor for distribution. ORCL (-65): ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms selling pressure. ADBE (-50): ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both confirm weakness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership as semiconductors lead while mega-cap software is weak. INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) and JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is major-cap Tech divergence and headline-driven sentiment on ORCL/ADBE/TSLA—watch for confirmation before shifting stance.
